title: 2025 Russell Reconstitution: Key Facts for Institutions - Callan
snippet: Palantir and Applovin’ leave the Russell Mid Cap Growth Index, creating big swings in sector allocation. Palantir and Applovin’ dominated the Russell Mid Cap Growth Index in 2024 both in weightings and contribution to benchmark performance. The combined weighting of these two stocks was nearly 10% of the benchmark, and both stocks experienced incredible appreciation in 2024 (with Applovin’ stock being up 700+%!).
